messages:
jen: hey everyone :wave: i'm jen (joined today) — quick qs about slack etiquette and where to ask things. vpn/badge setup is done but i'm not sure where to post infra vs product questions.
maya: welcome jen!! :tada: for infra/networking/ops ask in #eng-infra or ping @sam (infra lead). for product/feature questions use #product.
jen: thanks! also — there's a ton of bot noise on my feed. how do i mute non-critical bots but keep on-call alerts?
sam: good call — opt out of noisy bots via the bot settings or use the subscribe command. e.g., for the deploy bot: `@deploy-bot unsubscribe` or click the bot's profile -> more -> mute. for on-call alerts, keep `@pagerduty-bot` and `#eng-oncall` unmuted.
ben: devex tip: we have a personal-channel filter list in the onboarding doc: https://intranet.redwood.company/onboarding/slack-filters. if you want, I can DM a quick list to mute (ci-build, deploy-notify, benchbot).
jen: could you send that dm? also when should i post in a thread vs a new message?
maya: always thread to keep channels tidy. start a new thread if it's a different topic. DM for private stuff (access tokens, payroll). use @here/@channel sparingly — only for real-time or critical heads-up.
emily: heads-up on etiquette: use the channel topic for one-line guidelines (e.g., `#eng-platform: outages, deploys, RFCs`). update notification preferences: Preferences -> Notifications -> My keywords.
ben: another small trick: set headphone hours with the mobile app and then use the Slack do-not-disturb schedule if you want quiet windows.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: a deploy started for service 'inference-runtime' — build #4521. See details: https://ci.redwood.company/4521
jen: noted. last q — how do I subscribe to lunch plans and random?
maya: join #lunch-plans via the channel browser or click the join button. for social channels, mute notifications but stay joined. :thumbsup:
jen: awesome, super helpful — thanks y'all :smile: I'll DM ben for the mute list.
ben: sending now. welcome aboard! :rocket:
